scope: The pinned upstream neural_net_mod module is compiled with an audited, generated fixed-weight model: two inputs, two ReLU hidden units and one output in REAL32. Operator generation uses the author Model/Dense/Activation API and NumPy 2.2.6; neither TensorFlow, PyTorch nor Python inference runs in visitor jobs. The generator sorts the imported layer routine names for reproducibility; network operations are unchanged. Four inputs exercise positive and clipped hidden units and predictions are checked against independently evaluated weights and biases, including negative and positive outputs and finiteness. K covers inference as approximation; no least-squares fitting or training classification is inferred. The sample network is illustrative, not a trained scientific model. Other network layers, external model conversion and training are not verified. BSD-3-Clause and Crown copyright notices are retained.
initial_preparation_findings: The upstream Model/Dense/Activation API generates a fixed-weight network using only NumPy 2.2.6. Imported procedure names are sorted for platform-independent generation. The original Fortran inference module is unchanged; no Python training framework or interpreter is needed for visitor execution.
generated_source_support: See ../../fpm-generated-sources.md. Configuration is generated and reviewed by the operator; visitors install the locked asset.
